title: DecisionPointContract
description: Schema for detected operational decision points in CAT Trajectory Consequence Engine.

decision_point_id.description: Unique identifier for the detected decision point.

operator_id.description: Identifier of the active machine operator.

task_id.description: Identifier of the current operational task.

trigger_type.description: Classification of the operational condition triggering the decision point.

severity.description: Urgency and impact level of the decision point.

summary.description: Concise natural language summary of the detected situation.

evidence.description: Telemetry and operational signals supporting the detection.

available_actions.description: List of candidate action IDs evaluated for this decision point.
